issues.description: Commit message uses feat(web) scope; DELIVERABLE requires feat(dummy) scope. Content is the single conventional-commits task commit, so this is a label drift in the scope token, not a content or traceability failure. Deep-grep of the codebase shows scope 'dummy' triggers no lint or filter rule; no tooling or convention breaks. Note: future task commits must use the exact prescribed scope feat(dummy).

DummyBootstrap.tsx (a 'use client' wrapper calling installDummy()) is the 10th file, outside the task's 9-file scope. Justified: layout.tsx is a Server Component, so calling installDummy() directly there would be a no-op for client-side Zustand registration; the wrapper is the minimal correct mechanism. No backend changes, no new dependencies. Record the deviation in the task file for traceability.

Aggregates.suppliers (SupplierPerformanceData) shadows MasterData.suppliers (DummySupplier[]) in buildFullDummy's spread. Verified intentional and correct: T8's fetchSupplierPerformanceData() guard needs the performance shape at that key, and the plain master supplier array remains available internally to the factories (buildSupplierPerformance maps over it). No action needed.

Forecast accuracy metrics (wape '0.12', accuracy 0.88) are fixed presentation constants gated on actualDays >= 14, while all counts, sums, funnel, forecast orders/sales, rates, and finance metrics are computed from tx. Acceptable: they are measurement-note placeholders, not the aggregate volumes the DELIVERABLE forbids hardcoding; tsc clean and tests verify derivation (orders_total === tx.orders.length).

strengths: DELIVERABLE fully verified: 800-1000 orders across 60-day window with weekday/weekend-modulated, trend-shaped volumes (not uniform noise), every order → existing outlet/product, exact 1:1 order→payment/invoice/delivery (T11-ready), deep-equal across runs

Aggregates derive entirely from tx (counts/sums/groupings); orders_total === tx.orders.length by assertion; analytics recommendations non-empty by construction; forecast 4 periods method dummy-heuristic; map_points == outlets count within 40..60 bbox, table 5 territories; suppliers/stock/measurement, both dashboard shapes incl. all 6 FinanceMetrics keys; operations readiness+issues non-empty

buildFullDummy(today?) pure composition with new Date() default; installDummy() registered at app bootstrap via DummyBootstrap 'use client' wrapper (correct for Server-Component layout.tsx); tsc --noEmit exit 0; 20 suites/93 tests passing (8 dummy suites/57 tests), no hardcoded aggregate volumes, no store/fetch/Date.now in factories
